NZ vs IND, 2nd ODI LIVE streaming info: When, where to watch India v New Zealand match?
 IND vs NZ: Here is everything you need to know about the livestream and telecast details of the second ODI between India and New Zealand.

 | Photo Credit: AP
 India will look to extend its lead in the five-match ODI series against New Zealand when they meet in the second fixture in Wellington on Saturday.
 India heads into the tie with an advantage after a convincing five-wicket victory (DLS method) in a rain-affected series opener in Auckland.
 Much of the news leading into the series focused on India’s inexperienced pace bowlers; however, Gurnoor Brar, Anshul Kamboj, and Arshdeep Singh have taken the first step toward changing the narrative with strong performances in the first match.
 READ FULL PREVIEW 
 What time will the India vs New Zealand 2nd ODI start?
 The India vs New Zealand second ODI is scheduled to begin at 7:30 AM IST on Saturday, November 6.
 What time is the toss for the India vs New Zealand 2nd ODI?
 The toss for the India vs New Zealand second ODI is scheduled to take place at 7 AM IST.
 Where will the India vs New Zealand 2nd ODI be played?
 The India vs New Zealand second ODI will be played at Hnry Stadium in Wellington.
 Where will the India vs New Zealand 2nd ODI be streamed live?
 The India vs New Zealand second ODI will be streamed live on the SonyLIV app and website and televised live on the Sony Sports Network .
